how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Kozhikode Support Engineer (IT) Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Kozhikode to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Kozhikode Support Engineer (IT) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIM Kozhikode Support Engineer (IT) recruitment is 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Support Engineer (IT) post?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications include B.Tech/BE/MCA/M.Sc with 55% marks and 1 year experience, or BCA/B.Sc with 55% marks and 2 years experience, or a 3-year Diploma with 55% marks and 2 years experience in relevant fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Support Engineer (IT) post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Support Engineer (IT) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 24300 Per Month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Support Engineer (IT) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Support Engineer (IT) post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve screening followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. In which city and state is this job located?
faq.answer: The job is located in Kozhikode, Kerala.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Official Notification PDF' link provided in the Important Links section of this article.
